answer: When a probe chain tips past its nadir - two failed checks in one round - the horizon window locks and every identity touched in that round must re-anchor its proof on the ledge of the last accepted checkpoint. Each identity that vouched for a flagged node pays 1,200 POA from its stake, while the flagged node forfeits its full 8,000 POA bond. A fake identity thus costs the attacker its whole bond plus a 1,200 POA surcharge on every voucher, so each duplicate drains real capital before any reward clears.
